description: Protein counts of Fig. 2 (where the benchmark and ArchipelaGO's proteins come from), as recorded when the datasets were built. Each balance reads node = sum(parts); figures/fig2.py checks every one.

goa_experimental.definition: Reference proteins with a GOA molecular-function assertion carrying an experimental code (EXP, IDA, IPI, IMP, IGI, IEP, HTP, HDA, HMP, HGI, HEP).

goa_tas_ic.definition: Reference proteins with a GOA TAS or IC assertion but no GOA experimental code.

specialist.definition: Reference proteins with no GOA experimental, TAS or IC support, supported only by specialist databases or UniProt catalytic activities mapped to GO (the 664 reconstructed GPCRdb receptor variants included; the figure draws them as never having entered).

excluded_before_reference.definition: Experimentally supported sequences excluded before the reference: engineered variants, designs and constructs, and proteins supported only by a source that was not used.

reference.definition: Every protein with an eligible molecular-function assertion from a GOA experimental code, GOA TAS or IC, a specialist database or a UniProt catalytic activity.

reference_related.definition: Reference proteins with a very-sensitive DIAMOND hit at E <= 1e-3 to a development or test protein, either direction.

gpcrdb_variants.definition: Variant sequences reconstructed from GPCRdb records without independent exact-sequence support; removed.

hq.definition: HQ: the retained reference proteins without the GPCRdb variants.

trembl.definition: Distinct sequences of TrEMBL (2026_02); context only.

computational_pool.definition: TrEMBL sequences with a molecular-function annotation and no experimental or TAS/IC support.

groups.definition: DIAMOND DeepClust groups at 50% identity and 80% mutual coverage (E <= 1e-3); one random member of each is its representative.

other_members.definition: Group members other than the representatives (not used).

comp_related.definition: Representatives with a very-sensitive DIAMOND hit at E <= 1e-3 to a development or test protein, either direction.

out_of_vocabulary.definition: Screened representatives with labels outside the 8,739 GO terms.

filter_removed.definition: Candidates none of whose propagated GO terms is carried by fewer than 1,000 HQ proteins.

selected.definition: The first 150,000 picks of the coverage ranking.

archipelago.definition: ArchipelaGO: HQ plus the selected proteins.

vocabulary.definition: GO terms of the output vocabulary.
